findings.evidence: Basic.lean:144-165 bodies are `g.projOrthogonal_apply_self F.timelike.ne'`, `g.projOrthogonal_eq_self_iff F.timelike.ne'`, `g.projOrthogonal_projOrthogonal F.timelike.ne' p`, `g.ker_projOrthogonal F.timelike.ne'`, `g.range_projOrthogonal F.timelike.ne'`; the generic lemmas are at DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean:69,74,80,85,99. grep for `spatialPart_n|spatialPart_eq_self_iff|spatialPart_spatialPart|ker_spatialPart|range_spatialPart` finds no call site outside their own declarations.
findings.fix: Delete these five; at any future use site write `g.ker_projOrthogonal F.timelike.ne'` etc. directly (`F.spatialPart` is `g.projOrthogonal F.n` by definition, so they apply verbatim). Keep `spatialPart_def`, `spatialPart_apply` and `spatialPart_orthogonal_n`, which the rest of the file consumes.
findings.issue: Parallel API: `spatialPart_n` (144), `spatialPart_eq_self_iff` (147), `spatialPart_spatialPart` (152), `ker_spatialPart` (156) and `range_spatialPart` (162) restate `Bilin.projOrthogonal_apply_self`, `projOrthogonal_eq_self_iff`, `projOrthogonal_projOrthogonal`, `ker_projOrthogonal` and `range_projOrthogonal` with `u := F.n`; each proof is a single application of the generic lemma, and none is used in this PR or named by the roadmap's §1.1 (Suggested.lean:103-120 asks only for orthogonality, linearity of the energy, and the massless norm).

findings.evidence: Tensors/Basic.lean:136-151 hand-rolls the structure; the combinator used by the PR is at DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean:56-57 (`Module.preReflection u ((g u u)⁻¹ • g.flip u)`), and Mathlib supplies `Module.preReflection_apply` / `preReflection_apply_self` at upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Reflection.lean:74-82.
findings.fix: Define `reflect g u := Module.preReflection u ((2 * (g u u)⁻¹) • g u)`, deleting the `map_add'`/`map_smul'` plumbing; `reflect_apply` then follows by `simp [Module.preReflection_apply]` and `reflect_apply_self` from Mathlib's `Module.preReflection_apply_self` (`preReflection x f x = -x` given `f x = 2`), discharging `f u = 2` with `inv_mul_cancel₀ hu`.
findings.issue: `Bilin.reflect` is a near-clone of the new `Bilin.projOrthogonal` (both `v ↦ v - f v • u` with `f = c • g u`, both unconditional, same `g u u = 0` degeneration note), but it still assembles the linear map from raw pieces with 16 lines of manual `map_add'`/`map_smul'`, while the PR's new definition uses the `Module.preReflection` combinator one line away in the same project.

summary: The new material reuses Mathlib and the new Bilin.projOrthogonal correctly, but five Frame.spatialPart lemmas are a 1:1 restatement of the generic projOrthogonal lemmas with no consumer, and the pre-existing Bilin.reflect still hand-rolls the linear-map assembly that the combinator this PR just located (Module.preReflection) provides.
